policy.purpose: Per-note limb/sticking overrides only. Never add, remove, move, retime, or reclassify chart notes.
policy.acceptance: Only add an override when the external performance passage materially matches the fixed chart passage and the striking limb is visually identifiable.
policy.rejection: If the external performance differs from the fixed chart, ignore that external passage instead of changing the chart.

references.usage: Hit placement context only; never used as per-note R/L authority.
R/L observation only where the visible performance passage matches the fixed project chart.
